entities.name: Bearer Resource Allocation Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to request bearer resource allocation from network

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE when bearer resource allocation request cannot be accepted

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction between UE and network

entities.name: ESM Cause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for rejecting the bearer resource allocation request

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: Optional IE indicating timer value for re-attempt restrictions

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Indicates whether UE is allowed to re-attempt the procedure

entities.name: Traffic Flow Template
entities.description: Defines packet filters for traffic flow aggregation

entities.name: T3480
entities.description: Timer associated with bearer resource allocation procedure

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after receiving BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT

entities.name: LIPA PDN connection or SIPTO at local network
entities.description: Condition where bearer resource allocation is for LIPA or SIPTO local network connection

entities.name: Release traffic flow aggregate description
entities.description: UE action to release traffic flow aggregate description associated with PTI

relations.description: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message contains PTI IE

BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message may contain Re-attempt indicator IE
LIPA/SIPTO connection condition requires ESM cause #60
